reason: I'd take the free 15-company sample, because that costs me nothing, but I'm not paying EUR 1,500 upfront this month. An agency already burned me, and I'm not entering the new country until next year, so there's no rush.
objection: The only number you commit to is 5 meetings. That works out to EUR 600 a meeting at best, and if you miss, I've lost EUR 1,500 for nothing. You never say how many meetings to expect or what my real cost per meeting will be. The 45-meetings case is one logistics client I can't check yet.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 sample companies are ones I'd actually want and the logistics reference tells me on a call what they paid per meeting and how many turned into deals, I'd sign. I'd sign faster if more of the money only became due once meetings had taken place.
